subject: Quick note about this afternoon
text:
Hello Professor,

I hope you're doing well. I wanted to give you a quick heads-up about a small travel issue affecting my plan to see you this afternoon. My usual bus route had a temporary closure near the library, so I need to take a longer route from the other side of campus. It should still get me there, but I might be five or ten minutes late instead of the usual arrival time.

If the earlier slot is no longer practical, I'm happy to wait until later or come back another day. Just let me know what works best for your schedule. Sorry for the late notice, and thank you for being understanding. I'll also bring the revised outline either way.

Thanks,
